_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/attachments/test_auras_had.py. t_ah_eidolon is Hateful Eidolon's trigger alone, on a 1/3 enchantment creature with nothing else printed. t_ah_mourner is the other half of enchanted_by on a departure, false: it gains 1 life whenever a creature that wasn't enchanted leaves. The Auras and creatures are tests/data/enchanted_by.cards.json's.

cards.name: Test Hateful Watcher
cards.oracle_text: Whenever an enchanted creature dies, draw a card for each Aura you controlled that was attached to it.

abilities.text: Whenever an enchanted creature dies, draw a card for each Aura you controlled that was attached to it.

cards.name: Test Bare Mourner
cards.oracle_text: Whenever a creature that wasn't enchanted leaves the battlefield, you gain 1 life.

abilities.text: Whenever a creature that wasn't enchanted leaves the battlefield, you gain 1 life.
